doc.title: About TJS2
doc.para: About TJS2 TJS2 is an object-oriented scripting language developed for the purpose of being embedded into applications. It also possesses characteristics of non-object-oriented languages, allowing authors to write in whatever way is easiest for them. The syntax is similar to JavaScriptTM and JavaTM, making it easy to learn.
About this manual This manual explains TJS2 from a syntax perspective. It also provides explanations of the classes and methods built into TJS2.
